comments.author: Due_Communication849
comments.body:
What type of strategy are you trading? Did you account for brokerage and slippage( most strategies die here).
And you might wanna test it from 2020 to 2026 
Since that would include all type of market regimes like bearish during covid sideways and bullish. If strategy still holds after this you can go live
Also it matters a lot what you are trading as well you should prefer a strategy that is universal not niche to one ticker

comments.author: brtf_
comments.body: For me, 60% win rate would make me nervous because you could write off a pretty big losing streak as just part of the process. Then if there's a regime change that invalidates the strategy, you won't know it until you've taken some hefty losses. That said, the fact that it works over 2+ years is a good sign
